scenarios.scenario-1: init-dsh creates the docs indexes, AGENTS.md, mygrace.config.json and a .gitignore that ignores .mygrace/.
scenarios.scenario-2: Existing files are skipped without --force, and an existing .gitignore is never rewritten.
scenarios.scenario-3: --force overwrites a stale AGENTS.md instead of silently keeping it.
scenarios.scenario-4: The generated config carries the documented defaults and the requested language/testRunner.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output (created/skipped lines) is asserted by the test; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.

notes.note-1: Release-level end-to-end coverage (packaged CLI, init-dsh, lint) lives in scripts/pack-smoke.ts (gate G1), not in this module verification.
notes.note-2: The .gitignore step protects the local trust record from ADR-1 (never commit .mygrace/).
